func_ov025_02111dec and func_ov025_02111e30 keep their address-derived names as C-linkage helpers taking the object as char *, the spelling include/decl_common.h gives both, and cast it to daObjDpBrock_c * to read named members. Each is really a daObjDpBrock_c method (they update the collider matrix and the own-model matrix), but a member spelling would coin two mangled names; that rename is separate work.

dBgW_KcMbg::SetFile and dBgActor_c::IsClsnInRange stay mangled: each takes Fix12<int> by value (wall 6az). func_020393d4 stays an unnamed arm9 helper, declared (int *, int) to agree with its definition in src/func_020393d4.c.
